title: Beats
theory: Two nearby frequencies superpose into a slow amplitude envelope: $f_{beat} = |f_1 - f_2|$ — the number of loud–soft cycles per second. On MEXT it arrives welded to Doppler (one direct path, one shifted path). For $v \ll V$, a source-motion beat is $\approx \dfrac{2fv}{V}$ — a handy first-order check on exact answers like 2014-Q5-(3) above.
